nv.name: Broad-Spectrum SPF 50+ Sunscreen
nv.description: A lightweight, non-greasy daily sunscreen providing broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection for all skin types.
nv.why_useful: Daily sun protection is important for melanocytic nevi (moles). UV exposure may influence existing moles over time. Sunscreen is one of the most evidence-backed protective measures for general skin health.
nv.how_to_use: Apply generously to all exposed areas 15–20 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2 hours, or after swimming or sweating. Use daily, even on cloudy days.
nv.precautions: Not a substitute for medical evaluation. Keep out of eyes. Discontinue if rash or irritation develops. Consult a dermatologist if you have concerns about any mole.

nv.name: Gentle Hydrating Facial Cleanser
nv.description: A mild, soap-free cleanser that effectively removes impurities without stripping the skin's natural moisture barrier.
nv.why_useful: Gentle cleansing supports a healthy skin barrier and helps keep the skin around moles clean and free of irritants that could cause unnecessary inflammation.
nv.how_to_use: Apply a small amount to damp face, gently massage in circular motions for 30 seconds, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Use morning and evening.
nv.precautions: Avoid applying directly to any irritated or broken skin areas. Not for use near eyes. Do not scrub mole areas aggressively.

nv.name: Vitamin C Antioxidant Serum
nv.description: A stabilised vitamin C serum that provides antioxidant protection, helping to neutralise free radicals from UV exposure and environmental stressors.
nv.why_useful: Antioxidants like Vitamin C may support overall skin health and provide an added layer of protection against UV-induced oxidative damage. Suitable for general skin maintenance.
nv.how_to_use: Apply 3–5 drops to clean, dry skin each morning before moisturiser and sunscreen. Begin with every other day to assess tolerance.
nv.precautions: May cause mild tingling on first use. Do not apply directly to lesions. Avoid use on broken or irritated skin. Always follow with sunscreen during the day.

nv.name: Oil-Free Non-Comedogenic Moisturiser
nv.description: A lightweight, non-greasy daily moisturiser formulated to provide lasting hydration without clogging pores.
nv.why_useful: Adequate skin hydration supports the skin barrier. Keeping skin well-moisturised reduces dryness and potential irritation in areas with moles.
nv.how_to_use: Apply a pea-sized amount to clean face after cleansing and any serums. Use morning and evening.
nv.precautions: Discontinue if irritation occurs. Avoid direct application on any actively changing or irritated mole. Keep away from eyes.

bkl.name: Gentle BHA Exfoliating Cleanser
bkl.description: A mild salicylic acid (BHA) cleanser that helps gently remove dead skin cells and support smoother skin texture.
bkl.why_useful: For benign keratosis-like lesions, gentle exfoliation may help support skin surface texture and reduce surface buildup. This is for general skin care only — not a treatment for the lesion itself.
bkl.how_to_use: Start with 2–3 times a week. Apply to wet skin, massage gently for 30–60 seconds, then rinse well. Always follow with moisturiser and sunscreen.
bkl.precautions: Do not apply directly to inflamed or bleeding lesions. Stop use if skin becomes dry, red, or irritated. Avoid use if pregnant or nursing. Always use sunscreen when using BHA products.

bkl.name: Broad-Spectrum SPF 50+ Sunscreen
bkl.description: Daily broad-spectrum sunscreen offering comprehensive UVA and UVB protection.
bkl.why_useful: UV exposure can worsen keratosis-like lesions and increase overall skin damage. Daily sun protection is an important part of managing these areas.
bkl.how_to_use: Apply generously to all exposed areas 15 minutes before going outdoors. Reapply every 2 hours.
bkl.precautions: Not a treatment for keratosis. Consult a dermatologist if lesions change in size, shape, or colour.

bkl.name: Ceramide Barrier Repair Moisturiser
bkl.description: A ceramide-rich cream that helps restore and maintain the skin's natural moisture barrier for long-lasting hydration.
bkl.why_useful: Maintaining a healthy skin barrier is important for keratosis-prone skin. Ceramides help reduce water loss and soothe dry, flaky areas of skin.
bkl.how_to_use: Apply a generous layer to clean face and body after cleansing. Use morning and evening for best results.
bkl.precautions: Not a treatment for keratosis. Consult a dermatologist for any worsening or changing lesions.

bkl.name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc Brightening Serum
bkl.description: A well-tolerated niacinamide serum that supports even skin tone, minimises pore appearance, and helps improve overall skin texture.
bkl.why_useful: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) may support even skin tone around benign keratosis areas for general skin maintenance. It is gentle and suitable for most skin types.
bkl.how_to_use: Apply 2–3 drops to cleansed skin before moisturiser, morning and evening.
bkl.precautions: For external use only. Not a treatment for skin conditions. Do not apply on open wounds or infected skin.

df.name: Broad-Spectrum SPF 50+ Sunscreen
df.description: Everyday broad-spectrum sun protection against UVA and UVB radiation.
df.why_useful: Protecting skin from UV exposure is important for all skin conditions. Sunscreen helps prevent further sun damage in areas around dermatofibromas.
df.how_to_use: Apply generously to all exposed areas 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2 hours.
df.precautions: Not a treatment for dermatofibroma. Consult a dermatologist if the lesion changes or becomes symptomatic.

df.name: Fragrance-Free Gentle Cleanser
df.description: A mild, soap-free cleanser suitable for everyday gentle cleansing of sensitive skin.
df.why_useful: Gentle cleansing avoids irritating dermatofibroma lesions and maintains overall skin hygiene without causing unnecessary inflammation.
df.how_to_use: Use twice daily with lukewarm water. Pat the skin dry gently — do not rub lesion areas.
df.precautions: Avoid scrubbing around lesion areas. Do not attempt to remove or scrape the lesion. Consult a dermatologist for any changes.

df.name: Hydrating Ceramide Moisturiser
df.description: A ceramide-based moisturiser that strengthens the skin barrier and provides lasting hydration.
df.why_useful: Keeping the skin around dermatofibromas well-hydrated reduces dryness and potential irritation in those areas.
df.how_to_use: Apply to clean face and body after cleansing. Use morning and evening.
df.precautions: Avoid rubbing or pressing on the lesion. Do not attempt self-removal of dermatofibromas — consult a dermatologist.

vasc.name: Centella Asiatica Calming Moisturiser
vasc.description: A calming, lightweight moisturiser enriched with Centella Asiatica (Cica) extract to soothe and strengthen reactive skin.
vasc.why_useful: Centella Asiatica is known for its calming and skin-repair properties, which may help support skin comfort around vascular lesion areas.
vasc.how_to_use: Apply a thin layer to cleansed skin morning and evening. Gently pat — do not rub over any active lesions.
vasc.precautions: For general skin care only. Not a treatment for vascular conditions. Avoid applying to broken skin. Consult a dermatologist for persistent vascular lesions.

vasc.name: Broad-Spectrum SPF 50+ Sunscreen
vasc.description: Daily mineral or chemical sunscreen providing comprehensive UV protection for vascular-prone skin.
vasc.why_useful: UV exposure can exacerbate vascular skin issues. Consistent sunscreen use is one of the most effective protective measures for vascular-prone skin.
vasc.how_to_use: Apply generously before going outdoors. Reapply every 2 hours and after sweating.
vasc.precautions: Not a treatment. Seek medical evaluation for any growing or changing vascular lesions.

vasc.name: Green Tea Antioxidant Face Serum
vasc.description: An antioxidant-rich serum featuring green tea extract (EGCG) and vitamin E to protect against environmental stressors.
vasc.why_useful: Green tea antioxidants may help reduce oxidative stress on vascular-prone skin. Suitable for general skin maintenance and daily protection.
vasc.how_to_use: Apply 3–4 drops to clean skin in the morning before moisturiser and sunscreen.
vasc.precautions: Not a treatment for vascular lesions. Avoid open or bleeding areas. Consult a doctor for medical concerns.

vasc.name: Gentle Soothing Facial Cleanser
vasc.description: A calming, low-irritation cleanser suitable for reactive and sensitive skin types with vascular concerns.
vasc.why_useful: Gentle cleansing without harsh ingredients helps minimise irritation and redness in skin with vascular conditions.
vasc.how_to_use: Use twice daily with cool or lukewarm water. Avoid hot water, which may worsen vascular redness.
vasc.precautions: Do not scrub over active lesions. Avoid very hot water on affected areas. Pat dry gently.

akiec.name: High-Protection SPF 50+ Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen
akiec.description: Maximum-protection daily sunscreen with comprehensive UVA and UVB protection. Suitable for daily use on all sun-exposed areas.
akiec.why_useful: UV exposure is a major contributing factor to actinic keratoses. Consistent, high-protection sunscreen use is strongly recommended by dermatologists as an important preventive measure during and after treatment.
akiec.how_to_use: Apply generously to all exposed skin 20 minutes before going outdoors. Reapply every 2 hours, or after swimming or sweating. Wear protective clothing and seek shade.
akiec.precautions: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Sunscreen is NOT a treatment for actinic keratoses. This product is for general skin protection ONLY. You must consult a qualified dermatologist for evaluation and appropriate treatment of this condition.

akiec.name: Ultra-Gentle Sensitive Skin Cleanser
akiec.description: A fragrance-free, soap-free cleanser specially formulated for sensitive and compromised skin.
akiec.why_useful: Gentle, non-irritating cleansing helps maintain skin hygiene without aggravating sensitive or treated skin areas. Use only as directed by your dermatologist during any treatment.
akiec.how_to_use: Use once or twice daily with lukewarm water. Avoid scrubbing. Pat dry gently with a clean towel.
akiec.precautions: ⚠️ Avoid scrubbing or irritating lesion areas. Do NOT attempt to self-treat actinic keratoses with any over-the-counter product. Consult a dermatologist for professional evaluation and treatment options.

bcc.name: High-Protection SPF 50+ Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen
bcc.description: Maximum-protection daily sunscreen for comprehensive UV protection during and after treatment.
bcc.why_useful: Sun protection is important for all skin conditions. UV exposure should be minimised while awaiting or during medical treatment. This is for general skin care ONLY and is not a treatment.
bcc.how_to_use: Apply generously before going outdoors. Reapply every 2 hours.
bcc.precautions: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This product is NOT a treatment for basal cell carcinoma. You MUST consult a qualified dermatologist or healthcare professional promptly for evaluation. Do not delay medical consultation.

bcc.name: Ultra-Gentle Fragrance-Free Cleanser
bcc.description: A mild, fragrance-free cleanser for sensitive or compromised skin during treatment periods.
bcc.why_useful: Gentle skin hygiene supports overall skin health. This is general skin care only and is NOT a treatment for any skin condition.
bcc.how_to_use: Use gently with lukewarm water. Pat dry — do not scrub or rub the affected area.
bcc.precautions: ⚠️ Do NOT apply any products directly to suspicious skin lesions without medical guidance. Consult a dermatologist without delay for evaluation.

mel.name: High-Protection SPF 50+ Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen
mel.description: Maximum-protection daily sunscreen with broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection.
mel.why_useful: Protecting all skin from UV exposure is universally important. While sunscreen is not a treatment, limiting UV exposure is universally recommended by dermatologists for overall skin health.
mel.how_to_use: Apply generously to all exposed areas before going outdoors. Reapply every 2 hours.
mel.precautions: ⚠️ CRITICAL: This product is NOT a treatment for melanoma or any other serious skin condition. If the AI result indicates a high-risk finding, please consult a qualified dermatologist or healthcare professional WITHOUT DELAY. Early professional evaluation is essential.
